## Shared Art Direction

- Positioning: national-level AI talent institute, innovation ecosystem, and research community.
- Visual idea: from frontier signals to emergent intelligence.
- Palette: deep space blue-black, midnight navy, electric cyan, spectral teal, innovation orange-red, silver gray, fog white.
- Form language: modular networks, signal fields, open paths, intelligence cores, and extensible grid systems.
- Tone: rigorous, future-facing, open, youthful, premium, and non-traditional academic.

## Generation Notes

The image-generation model may render Chinese or English text imperfectly. Treat text-heavy outputs as composition and style references; final production artwork should rebuild typography and official wording manually in vector design software.
